messages:
maria: Rolling canary to canary-2 now. Quick check: after merge 7b3f the KV cache hit-rate dropped for some feeds; p95 tokens latency up ~30% on long-context runs. Anyone seen this locally? :eyes:
chris: Saw the same on g5 test. CI perf job failed on perf/regressions/seq-1024 — bisect points to runtime/kernel/allocator.cc change in that merge.
jin: Reproducer: ran perf harness with --seq_len=1024 --model=redwood-v1 --batch=1. p95 before=120ms now=156ms. Logs suggest an extra memcpy in select_kernel path.
tara: Could be KV cache eviction/lookup path. New kernel selection heuristics might pick a non-kv-optimized kernel for long contexts.
maria: Telemetry confirms: KV cache hit-rate for the affected route dropped from 0.82 -> 0.55 after the merge.
alex: Can we pause the canary until we confirm root cause? Our rollout guardrail should pause on >15% p95 regression.
maria: I'll put the roll out on hold. @deploy-bot please pause rollout: /rollout pause canary-2 --reason "p95 regression seq>1024"
deploy-bot: ✅ Rollout paused for canary-2 by maria. Notifying oncall.
jin: I'll bisect further. Early hypothesis: kernel_selector now computes score() per token/step and triggers extra memcpys; previously decision was cached per request chunk.
chris: I ran a perf-profile and dumped hotspots: a lot of time in memcpy + kernel_selector::score(). Snippet:
```
hotspots:
  memcpy 34%
  kernel_selector::score 22%
  kv_cache::lookup 12%
```
tara: If score() is being invoked more frequently, that can add overhead per token. We should memoize the choice per (seq_len_bin, batch_size) at minimum.
jin: Quick patch: memoize selector decision keyed by (seq_len_bin,batch). Local microbench: p95 back to baseline. I'll open a PR.
maria: Also can we add a pre-promotion canary gate to CI that runs the long-context seq=1024 perf check against the canary pool? Right now our preflight only runs seq=512.
alex: +1 to that and add a KV hit-rate telemetry gate. If hit-rate drops >20% vs baseline the rollout auto-pauses.
tara: And add perf-bot alerting: if multiple A/B buckets show >20% p95 regression for 5 minutes, trigger auto-rollback.
perf-bot: note: created perf regression ticket #INF-1127 and scheduled an expedited CI run against canary-2.
maria: Thanks — Jin please link PR and we can unpause after we validate and the telemetry thresholds are in place.
jin: PR: https://repo/repo/pull/432 - includes memoize + unit perf test. Ran on canary-2 preflight and looks good. Requesting review @chris @tara
chris: Reviewing now. If green, resume canary with the stricter SLO gate enabled.
maria: I'll leave canary paused until green + telemetry thresholds are live.
